source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Corvette Body, p.1B-28

procedures.title: Scratched panels, spot refinishing
steps: Strip all paint around the scratch down to the plastic using Lacquer Removing Solvent.
Featheredge the area with No. 220 wet-or-dry paper, then block sand to finish with No. 320 wet-or-dry paper (see figure 63 in the manual).
Clean the area with Prep-Sol or equivalent, then wipe with a tack rag.
Mask adjoining panels before painting, using only non-staining masking tape on the plastic body.
notes: Caution: avoid sanding deep into the glass mat; if you must cut fairly deep, use the dents-and-pits repair instead.
Figures on this page (44 marking hinge position, 45 removing hinge spring, 46 installing tool J-9559 in new spring, 47 gas tank door and rear trim) belong to other procedures.
